features: History includes every chess tournament in the annual schedule from day one, along with actual records. Calendar tournaments precede supplemental World Circuit groups. Optional recorded-only filter.
Standings shows announced individual entrants with names/country/Elo before play, actual scores after rounds, and expandable national squads. Future squads clearly labelled projected.

Unentered calendar events run through existing Swiss/RR/BO3/knockout/match and national team simulators during daily progression, update actual NPC histories/ratings, and archive named rosters/pairings/results.
Human bookings are reserved, active calendar participants excluded from overlapping events and World Circuit, no automatic human matches/prizes, one-time daily cursor prevents re-settlement.
Engine spectator checkpoints also support current playable rounds in NPC-only calendar events, retain moves/clocks/result on reload and settle with the normal round.
City selector default 12 to 62, search cap 40 to 90; 50 additional real seed/NPC/fallback places per country with sufficient data; separate England/Scotland/Wales datasets.

limits: Every event means the game chess schedule, not every real-world tournament. Standalone Esports continues in its existing separate section.
Old missing results/entrants are not reconstructed from current NPCs. The catalogue still shows these events with explicit no-result text; future events have no invented scores.
A tournament needs enough eligible available NPCs to run. Human registered events retain their original player-controlled workflow.
National squads may be projections before starting. Completed NPC national events store all actual team rosters and recorded boards.
No invented PGNs: only viewed engine games record moves, and partial recordings are labelled. Other NPC events use the existing abstract result model.
